cold_start: Fresh model/controller/graph per method and output-length cell; separate initially empty compiler caches per method, then reused within same method as rollout lengths increase. No overlap on GPU. Cold complete API call includes all compiler and graph work. First two calls recorded separately.
timing: Original author synchronized measure(runner) and result destruction. Fresh original model B2 root, every static input refreshed, entire unchanged finite GPU graph replay, strict predicates and all CPU output conversion included.
memory: Every first/cold and warm API peak allocated/reserved, model load/setup and current host/lifetime highwater costs recorded per independently initialized method/rollout geometry. No inferred missing latency or memory points.
exclusions: No runs excluded. No filtering of slow repetitions or post-hoc early stopping for a winning subset.
correctness: All complete signed vectors saved in NPZ, SHA-verified against JSON audit. DT runs all original finite predicates and native decoder/FA boundary checks at every length. Actual total<=1024 additionally compared exactly with unchanged retained vector and scalar/layer values. Longer full-logit retained comparison is not claimed.
graph_build: One persistent stream, two complete model-root plus finite warmups, one complete program capture and one GPU replay inside first call. Warm buffers and unused previous graph pool freed with all costs charged; no internal peak reset.
graph_validation: Original829 finite predicates and720 replay version observations retained, plus36 original-input equality predicates when SAC active. Full original root score, native decoder boundary and public auxiliary FA checks. Full CPU vector and statistics before return. Source/state contract on every call.
purpose: Final single rollout-length efficiency figure: source-pinned v2 DT and two unchanged FT curves on one C550. All longer-memory limits measured and recorded; the four fixed-output32 speed/capacity acceptance bins do not imply lower memory at every rollout length.
accounting: Complete original synchronized author timer with result destruction. Report resident allocated/reserved before and after, peak allocated/reserved, current host RSS and process RSS highwater; model load, setup, runner init, audits, cold calls and close separate. CUDA host section timing is not GPU kernel timing.

acceptance.plot: Same matched input SHA across new DT and both FT at every cell. No rescaled or interpolated measurements. Hardware/timing distinctions visible in one figure. Short-input confirmation gate remains separate.

candidate_scope: Qwen3-8B FP16 B1/E2 fixed eval FA2 model. Full original native head shape; unchanged full finite seed and native GEMM shapes; original FP32 post-attention RMS boundary. Bounded native target log-prob rows64; original target sums unchanged. Earlier storage release and16 cached q projections at long geometries. Public same-root SAC; all strict predicates and full CPU return retained; every cold/capture cost charged.
summary: Mean of all three measured full calls, with min/max range; first and second warm calls, all failures, cold/model/setup/allocated/reserved/RSS cost fields retained separately. All five rows required successful for a timed curve point; missing or OOM cells have no fabricated latency.

published_reference.methods: Seven original non-FT methods; source rows and hashes preserved. Author-released successful measurements, different GPU counts; reference only.
